summary_en: M3 announced a public tender offer for up to 50 billion yen of its shares, expanding the buyback authorization previously set in May 2026. The offer price will be 12% discounted from the lower of the November 19 closing price or one-month VWAP, with Sony Group (34.63% shareholder) indicating willingness to participate subject to economic terms.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Public Tender Offer for Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 20, 2026, M3's board of directors resolved to conduct a public tender offer for treasury stock, expanding the buyback framework initially announced on May 1, 2026. The company plans to acquire up to 50 billion yen of its ordinary shares through the tender offer, combined with an expansion of the previously authorized 20 million share (3.00% of outstanding shares) and 20 billion yen acquisition framework.

The offer price will be determined by applying a 12% discount to the lower of two benchmarks: the closing price on November 19, 2026 (the business day before the board resolution) or the simple average closing price for the one-month period ending November 19, 2026, both on the TSE Prime Market. This discount rate was chosen after reviewing similar tender offer cases conducted between October 1, 2024 and September 30, 2026, where 10% was most common but the board determined 12% appropriate given the company's stock price volatility and desire to minimize outflows of corporate assets.

Sony Group Corporation, which owns 230.46 million shares (34.63% of outstanding shares), has indicated its willingness to consider selling part of its M3 holdings subject to economically reasonable terms. The board determined that a public tender offer structure best ensures equal treatment among shareholders and transaction transparency by providing all shareholders a defined participation period and market price reference, rather than a private placement.
